label: W6-3
reason: Observe done (about 1 h 50 min). The mechanism is a 0011 defect walking through 110 fields: the head shuttles between the defect and a unary counter at the right end, one block per round trip. Three exact visit rules R1-R3 (main walk, walk that eats the second field, the same walk inside the second field) are validated 25/25 each from random instances. When the active defect reaches the junk before the counter, the head sweeps to the left edge and a new epoch starts. The epoch law, fitted on 22 resets to 1.63e10, is N' ~ N + 1.22M, M' ~ 0.30N - 0.58M (eigenvalues 1.20, -0.78); each phase ends on a remainder (mod 6, 8, 2) that picks the junk and the next branch. That is the pre-registered W6-3 stop rule (a field divided, branches on residues), so the cryptid protocol applies: rules formalized in observe.json, flagged, stopped. Unlike H-4, no branch is known to halt: halting needs D to read 0011 from its left, which no observed branch does, and ~5e5 epochs (Alistaire's 10^73975 steps) passed without a halt. A proof would need a closed census of branch shapes plus a 2-D band invariant on M/N (0.06..0.25 seen).
